command:
ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIALS=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop link.localclimate.app; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity; sleep 1; printf '%s
' '--- before Back ---'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent 4; sleep 1; printf '%s
' '--- after Back ---'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' || true; if "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' | grep -q 'link.localclimate.app'; then echo 'root Back did not leave app' >&2; exit 1; fi
